name: Chthonic-Corrie
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by glass plains from an ancient cataclysm and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
